facts.fact: 他晚上回到她公寓时眼神空洞、像见了鬼一样（这是比喻，不是真有鬼出现）。
facts.anchor: His eyes are lifeless. He looks like he’s seen a ghost.

facts.fact: 猫 Wilfred 不知从哪冒出来，蜷在他身旁陪他。
facts.anchor: Wilfred appears out of nowhere and curls up beside him.

facts.fact: 他带回的消息是 Agency 改了主意。
她只剩四天，比原先约定的八周短得多。
合同撕不掉，因为人类无法销毁管辖他们工作的文件，这是很久以前设的保险。
facts.anchor: “Humans cannot destroy the documents that govern our work,” he says softly.

facts.fact: 他半夜冒雨回来给的方案是：毁掉 Agency 档案里的原件，她就自由了。
facts.anchor: “If we destroy the original,” he says, “you will be free.”

facts.fact: 他被派的最新一份备忘录是关于弹球机能不能提升职场士气的，署名为「THE MANAGEMENT」。
facts.anchor: In no more than five sentences, please describe whether Lucy agrees that pinball machines are a good way to bolster workplace morale.

facts.fact: 她决定亲自去 Agency 教他们怎么做人，结尾是这句「那我就去做」。
facts.anchor: I lean forward and cup his face in my hands. “Then I’m doing it.”
